privacy.intro: This page explains, in plain words, how Loomora handles your data today in guest mode and with an account.

s1.title: Guest mode (on your device)
s1.body: You can use Loomora without signing up. In guest mode, your to-dos (including subtasks, notes, priorities, repeat rules, and reminders), schedule items, check-ins, daily intentions, and display settings stay on your device in your browser’s IndexedDB storage. Loomora also saves a small localStorage flag to remember when you dismiss the “Save your plan” prompt.

items.i1: Guest plan data is not sent to our servers unless you create or sign into an account to import it, or choose to send feedback.
items.i2: If you clear your browser’s site data, switch browsers, or lose your device, your local guest data is gone and Loomora cannot restore it.

s2.title: Account mode (stored remotely)
s2.body: Creating an account is optional. When you sign up or sign in with email and password or with Google, Loomora sends your plan and account details to the Loomora API and stores them in a remote PostgreSQL database.

items.i1: Account and authentication details: email address, display name, time zone, display settings (12h/24h and week start), a hashed password (for email accounts), a Google account ID and verified email status (for Google sign-in), and optional sign-up survey answers (your main goal and how you heard about Loomora).
items.i2: Plan data: your to-dos, subtasks, notes, reminders, schedule items, exceptions, check-ins, daily intentions, and your current streak, longest streak, and last counted streak date.
items.i3: Session storage: the app stores a 30-day API access token and basic profile details in your browser’s localStorage so you stay signed in across reloads and tabs.
items.i4: Guest import: if you have a guest plan on your device when you sign up or sign in, Loomora imports those records to your account and removes the imported plan data from local IndexedDB once every import batch succeeds.

s3.title: Feedback
s3.body: Both guests and signed-in users can use Send feedback in Profile. Submitted messages are stored in our PostgreSQL database. If you are signed in, your message is linked to your account and your account name and email may be included as a reply-to address when feedback emails are enabled.

s4.title: Hosting, email, and third-party services
s4.body: Loomora is a student-developed project that relies on external infrastructure providers to run the web app, API, database, optional Google sign-in, and emails:

items.i1: Vercel is configured to host and deliver the web app.
items.i2: Render is configured to host the Loomora backend API.
items.i3: Neon (PostgreSQL) is documented in project setup as the remote database host for account and feedback records.
items.i4: Google sign-in is used only if you choose “Sign in with Google” or “Sign up with Google” (requesting basic profile and email).
items.i5: Brevo is configured in the backend to send account confirmation links, password reset links, and forwarded feedback emails.
items.i6: Like most web and API providers, these hosts may keep standard server or request logs (such as IP addresses and timestamps).

s5.title: Offline caching (service worker)
s5.body: Loomora registers a service worker to cache the app files (code, styles, icons, and bundled fonts) on your device so the app can open offline.

items.i1: In guest mode, you can view and edit your local plan offline.
items.i2: In account mode, saving or loading changes requires an internet connection; offline edits are not queued or saved until you are back online.

s6.title: Deleting your data and account
s6.body: How you remove your data depends on whether you use guest mode or an account:

items.i1: Guest mode: clear this site’s data in your browser settings to erase local IndexedDB data and any saved session token. This does not delete feedback messages already sent to the server.
items.i2: Accounts with a password: open Profile, choose Delete my account, and enter your current password to immediately delete your user record, tokens, password-reset tokens, to-dos (including soft-deleted to-dos), schedule items, exceptions, check-ins, daily intentions, and account-linked feedback from the app database, and sign out on this device. Separate local browser data or feedback emails already delivered to an inbox are not removed automatically.
items.i3: Google-only accounts (without a password): in-app deletion requires Google verification and a separate final confirmation. Availability depends on whether Google verification is enabled.
items.i4: Soft-deleted to-dos: deleting a to-do in an account keeps it soft-deleted so you can undo or restore it for up to 7 days; automatic cleanup of older soft-deleted to-dos is not implemented yet, so those rows remain in the database until your account is deleted.

s7.title: Contact and open publication details
s7.body: Loomora is a student-developed app still in active development. You can send questions or reports through Send feedback in Profile. A dedicated operator contact email, data retention and backup schedule, hosting analytics and data-sharing disclosures, and an official effective date require owner confirmation before public launch.

terms.intro: These are the plain-English rules for using Loomora.

s1.title: Using Loomora
s1.body: Loomora is a free, student-developed planner for your own to-dos and weekly schedule. Use it for yourself and be kind to others.

s2.title: Guest mode vs. account mode
s2.body: You can use Loomora without an account or sign up to sync your plan:

items.i1: Guest mode: your plan is saved locally in your browser on your device. If you clear your browser data, switch browsers, or lose the device, your local plan is gone.
items.i2: Account mode: your plan is saved to your account on our remote server so you can access it across devices. You are responsible for keeping your password and signed-in devices secure.

s3.title: Accounts and deletion
s3.body: Creating an account is optional. You can sign up with email and password or with Google. Accounts that have a password can be deleted in Profile. Deleting a Google-only account in the app requires Google verification when the feature is enabled, followed by a separate final confirmation.

s4.title: Early software and offline limits
s4.body: Loomora is early student-developed software provided as it is, with no promises of uptime, backups, or error-free operation. While a service worker caches the app for offline opening and guest mode works offline, account features require an internet connection and depend on third-party hosting and email providers.

s5.title: Fair use
s5.body: Please do not try to break, overload, or bypass limits on Loomora, or use it to harm others.

s6.title: Changes
s6.body: These terms and the Privacy page may change as Loomora is developed. The date at the top shows when this text was last updated, and formal operator contact and legal publication details still require owner approval before public launch.
